# MftPhysicalSeed.Contracts.ps1

Defines read-only MFT inventory/provenance gates: `Assert-MftPhysicalSeedInventory`, `Get-MftPhysicalSeedInventory`, `Assert-MftSeedCreationEvidence`, `Assert-MftIndependentWriteMonitorEvidence`, `Get-MftObjectSha256`, and `Assert-MftFinalAcceptanceSeedProvenance`. It validates live attached VHDX/disk/partition/volume identity and protected host roles, binds the v2 marker and create-new intent to the completion record, and requires a separately supplied monitor artifact before benchmark or final aggregation.

The monitor schema is `StorageChronicle.MftSeedWriteMonitorEvidence.v1`. Required claims include an identified independent collector, finalized/complete trace, zero lost/dropped events, raw source-trace SHA-256, monitor output path outside creator roots, capture timestamps spanning intent through completion, read-only before/after protected host inventories, exact VHDX/disk/volume/workload identity, PID/start-time/image-hash process identities, and successful allowlisted write operations only within the approved VHDX, run evidence, or exact workload root. Read/query events do not count as write coverage. Final acceptance rechecks manifest `AcceptanceEligible`, file hashes, provenance schemas/status, target identities, workload count, and creator/publisher/workload process identities against `MftEvidence.Environment`.

Dependencies: `MftSeedWorkflow.Contracts.ps1` for path/file hash/reparse helpers, Windows Storage/Hyper-V/CIM/registry read-only queries, and PowerShell JSON/file APIs. Any missing, legacy, tampered, incomplete, out-of-root or mismatched artifact throws and keeps acceptance blocked. `Test-MftPhysicalSeedContracts.ps1` uses in-memory fixtures/mocks for v1/v2 inventory, external monitor success and negative cases; it performs no disk/VHDX operations.
